newsitem.title: USA: Redbook to release retail sales Tues at 1355 EST.
newsitem.headline: Redbook to release retail sales Tues at 1355 EST.

text.p: So as not to conflict with the Federal Open Market Committee meeting's policy announcement on Tuesday afternoon, Redbook Research's weekly retail sales report will be released an hour earlier than usual, the firm said.
The report will be embargoed until 1355 EST/1855 GMT, but clients will receive the the data at 1320 EST/1820 GMT. Redbook said these are one-time changes.

"It aims to avoid a time conflict with any policy announcements that may be made by the U.S. Federal Reserve Board of Governors following the (FOMC) meeting on March 25," noted a news release. "Any announcements by the Fed would be issued at 2:15 p.m., close to the usual release time of the Redbook Index."
